items.markdown:
Student accommodation development finance is `a short-term funding solution used to build, convert, or deeply refurbish purpose-built student accommodation` (PBSA). Lenders typically finance up to 65%–75% of the total project costs (Loan-to-Cost) or are capped around 60%–75% of the gross development value, with funds released in monitored stages.[](https://www.securetrustbank.com/real-estate-finance/property-development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance) [[1]](https://www.securetrustbank.com/real-estate-finance/property-development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance)[[2]](https://studentaccommodationfinance.co.uk/guides/student-accommodation-development-finance/)[[3]](https://fundingfred.com/blog/development-finance-for-student-accommodation-and-co-living-schemes)How the Financing Works

- **Loan Structure:** Short-term facilities usually run from 18 to 60 months, with interest typically rolled up into the loan balance rather than serviced monthly.[](https://fundingfred.com/blog/development-finance-for-student-accommodation-and-co-living-schemes) 
- **Core Uses:** Ground-up construction of halls, office-to-student conversions, or large-scale HMO (House in Multiple Occupation) refurbishments.[](https://www.securetrustbank.com/real-estate-finance/property-development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance) [[1]](https://maffinancegroup.co.uk/sectors/student-accommodation-finance)[[2]](https://www.assetzcapital.co.uk/property-finance/development-finance/development-finance-for-student-accommodation/)
- **Exit Strategies:** Repayment is achieved either by refinancing into a long-term commercial investment mortgage once the building is operational and let, or through a forward sale to an institutional investor.[](https://fundingfred.com/blog/development-finance-for-student-accommodation-and-co-living-schemes) 

Key Lender Requirements

- **Proximity & Demand:** Lenders evaluate the local university's size, ranking, year-on-year student enrollment growth, and the asset's walking distance or transport links to campus.[](https://fundingfred.com/blog/development-finance-for-student-accommodation-and-co-living-schemes) [[1]](https://www.ennessglobal.com/real-estate-finance/student-accommodation-finance)
- **Planning Consent:** Full planning permission specifically designated for student residential or sui generis student use is normally required prior to final fund release.[](https://fundingfred.com/blog/development-finance-for-student-accommodation-and-co-living-schemes) 
- **Developer Track Record:** Because PBSA builds are specialized and less flexible than standard residential housing, lenders heavily scrutinize the experience of the developer and the professional delivery team.[](https://esteemacapital.com/development-finance-uk/student-accommodation-development-loan/) [[1]](https://esteemacapital.com/development-finance-uk/student-accommodation-development-loan/)[[2]](https://cfpgroup.co.uk/financial_product/purpose-built-student-accommodation-finance/)

To explore specialized lending options, you can review criteria from active market providers like [Paragon Bank Development Finance](https://www.paragonbank.co.uk/development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance) or [Shawbrook Property Finance](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance/).[[1]](https://www.paragonbank.co.uk/development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance)[[2]](https://www.shawbrook.co.uk/property-finance/development-finance/student-accommodation-development-finance/)If you'd like to discuss a specific project, please share:

- The **location and proximity** to the nearest higher education institution
- The **scale of the project** (number of beds or estimated Gross Development Value)
- Your **experience level** with similar commercial or student builds

I can help outline potential loan-to-cost metrics and key considerations for your scheme.
